AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#682 @ 007d3dcbb69ebb1b31f406602ab3b7db65889896 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES
A/B/C = 0/2/1

Independent T4 audit of F2's complete six-file, 2,529-line delta: transfer creation/adoption, post-await authority, operation identities, durable receipt/reversal recovery, bounded listing, retry/failure classification, monetary notice copy, all included tests and the complete provider/DB fakes. This verdict is for F2 only, not an approval of its parent or later pieces. [Exact-head scope](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/682#issuecomment-5975772668)

### Prior findings and evidence reuse

**B-627-10 CLOSED at its reported failed-park boundary:** current source uses the closed Prisma-class `ParkFailureKind` vocabulary and a fixed unknown fallback, rather than custom exception name/message/code; two independent current-source controls pass, including real `attempt()` fence loss plus failed parking, unchanged exception propagation and zero Stripe sends. [Current mapping and sink](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/007d3dcbb69ebb1b31f406602ab3b7db65889896/src/connect/fees/transfer-orchestrator.service.ts#L166-L184) [Executed closure controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37171535745)

The original failing-before run actually executes **two failed privacy canaries / nine passing controls**, supporting closure rather than relying on builder prose; earlier B-627-9 transfer-create closure remains retained, B-627-3 remains superseded by OR-111-1, and the separate C-627-10 key-column follow-up is not relabeled B. [Before proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37143889028) [Prior Sol disposition](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/627#issuecomment-5972047312) [Round 10](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/627#issuecomment-5972269313)

G09 reuse: verified byte identity against same-model original APPROVE `7c29d98121d931af04d68038f97aec601589e6a2` for payout copy and transfer-match controls, and unchanged reversal portions; reviewed the entire piece and all post-approval round-8/9/10 changes deeply, including main integration. Newly executed reversal/diagnostic counterexamples below override prior assumptions at those distinct boundaries, rather than copying any other lens's verdict. [Prior same-model evidence](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/627#issuecomment-5964131926) [Current source](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/007d3dcbb69ebb1b31f406602ab3b7db65889896/src/connect/fees/transfer-orchestrator.service.ts)

### B-682-1 — a paused reversal sender survives takeover and key expiry

**File:line:** `src/connect/fees/transfer-orchestrator.service.ts:1136–1153`; `drive()` proves the charge fence **before** awaiting the durable attempts write, then calls `reverseTransfer()` without post-await lease/operation reproof or a synchronous send-start admission budget. Completion at lines 1216–1240 can then silently return the earlier local receipt. [Unfenced continuation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/007d3dcbb69ebb1b31f406602ab3b7db65889896/src/connect/fees/transfer-orchestrator.service.ts#L1136-L1153) [Receipt completion](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/007d3dcbb69ebb1b31f406602ab3b7db65889896/src/connect/fees/transfer-orchestrator.service.ts#L1216-L1240)

**Executed counterexample:** worker A reserves a 400-cent reversal on a 1,000-cent paid transfer, passes the real charge fence, commits the attempt increment, and pauses before the HTTP call; after lease expiry worker B takes over using a second real `ChargeLock`, resolves that same operation once and records 400 cents. After the provider key expires, A resumes its pre-HTTP continuation and reverses another 400 cents: **external reversal 800 cents, local reversed total 400 cents**, with no second local operation. [Exact-source two-worker probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37171535745)

The provider model keeps durable reversal objects separate from its expiring request-key cache; this pause is **outside fetch**, so it is not the explicitly excluded frozen-inside-HTTP scenario documented for transfer creation. The reported ordinary takeover/listing closures are not generalized to a send continuation they did not protect. [Executed model and assertions](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37171535745) [Existing transfer-create admission contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/007d3dcbb69ebb1b31f406602ab3b7db65889896/src/connect/fees/transfer-orchestrator.service.ts#L411-L434)

**Minimal fix / verification:** give reversal sends an authoritative, bounded send-admission protocol: re-prove charge ownership and the current pending operation/send claim after every awaited claim write, and enforce the final start budget synchronously at the actual reversal HTTP boundary. A stale continuation must never send after takeover, completion or key expiry. Preserve unknown-outcome reconciliation and the existing same-operation identity; prove pre-HTTP pause, takeover, recovery, expired-key resumption and ordinary reversal controls with durable external receipts.

### B-682-2 — unrestricted diagnostics remain on other orchestrator branches

**File:line:** `src/connect/fees/transfer-orchestrator.service.ts:562–609, 802–807, 893–896, 950–955, 1156–1167, 1203–1208, 1252–1265`; ordinary send, listing, receipt, retry scheduling and reversal failures interpolate arbitrary exception messages into logger strings, and several also persist them into financial diagnostics or embed them in retryable exceptions. Fixing the one failed-park name sink does not sanitize these separate branches. [Send failure sinks](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/007d3dcbb69ebb1b31f406602ab3b7db65889896/src/connect/fees/transfer-orchestrator.service.ts#L562-L609) [Receipt/listing sinks](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/007d3dcbb69ebb1b31f406602ab3b7db65889896/src/connect/fees/transfer-orchestrator.service.ts#L802-L955) [Reversal sinks](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/007d3dcbb69ebb1b31f406602ab3b7db65889896/src/connect/fees/transfer-orchestrator.service.ts#L1156-L1265)

**Executed counterexamples:** four actual-service canaries independently inject unrestricted text at definitive Stripe refusal, unknown send outcome, listing failure and receipt-write failure; **all four reach `Logger.warn/error`**, while the two specific B-627-10 park-closure controls pass. This is a diagnostic boundary failure, not proof that actual customer PII was present in this synthetic run. [Executed four-case probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37171535745)

**Minimal fix / verification:** consistently map errors to closed class/code catalogs with fixed unknown fallback before logging, persisting diagnostics or constructing centrally reported money exceptions; preserve actionable fixed next-step text, IDs, amounts and retry semantics. No arbitrary message/name/code pass-through or token-shaped regex. Add canaries at all the listed send, receipt, recheck, listing and reversal boundaries.

### C-682-1 — inexpensive impersonal-copy correction

**File:line:** `src/connect/fees/payout-notice-copy.ts:65–68, 79, 93–103`; rendered notices use first-person phrasing, contrary to the standing copy direction. The independent $100 refund control renders “We took $94.80…” and “We will hold $5.20…”. This editorial issue is not promoted to a material money blocker. [Copy](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/007d3dcbb69ebb1b31f406602ab3b7db65889896/src/connect/fees/payout-notice-copy.ts#L65-L103) [Executed copy control](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37171535745)

**Minimal fix / verification:** make refund, dispute and release phrasing impersonal, keeping exact current amounts and the 160-character limit; add an all-event, both-role copy guard.

### Red-by-design attribution and executed evidence

The first current-head build also had the known Jest-worker OOM; one allowed failed-job rerun removed it. The rerun fails **exactly four tests in two old suites**: `purchase-split-handler.service.spec.ts` and `checkout-webhook-fee-split.spec.ts`, whose pre-F2 fakes lack `connectTransfer.updateMany` and consequently record zero expected Stripe calls. F4 carries those fixture/wiring updates; current `checkout.service.spec.ts` passes. No additional red remains. [Exact-head rerun](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37153346304/job/111344582169) [Operator red-by-design contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/682#issuecomment-5975772668)

That rerun reports **712 passed suites / 23 skipped suites; 12,302 passed tests / 239 skipped / 5 todo**. Other applicable candidate contexts succeed; main-only CodeQL/danger/banned-casts/SBOM do not run on this stacked base and are not claimed as passes. They remain required at the composed landing candidate. [Candidate checks](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/682/checks) [Landing contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/682)

Independent one-job CI uses the exact F2 head plus the probe and permitted wrapper, executing **six failed assertions** (one reversal, four diagnostic and one editorial) with **15 passing controls**, including all 13 piece controls and both B-627-10 closure controls; no fixture compilation failure. [Targeted audit run](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37171535745)

No heavy local test, candidate-branch push, merge, production/provider operation or deployment was performed. Current head was re-read before publication. Neither F1 nor F2 may land alone; after fixes, the complete stack still requires exact-head dual approvals and rule-11 composed green qualification.
